lines.en: Today is the day the second ‘transfer student’ is supposed to arrive.
I’ve already gone through this once before, so there’s no reason to get Makoto involved again.
Especially since now I know that the process requires signing one sheet of paper and standing around to make it look like I’m doing something.
Whoever this new girl is, though...I hope she’s a little calmer than Molly.
I like Molly, don’t get me wrong, it’s just...
Well, class has become significantly louder ever since she arrived.
Just as I’m about to walk into the classroom, I bump into someone who is most definitely not the transfer student.
But, to be fair, she might as well be. In fact, Molly’s only been here a few days and I’m pretty sure she’s attended class just as much as Yumi.
: Good morning, Yumi. Glad to see you made it to[school] today.
: It’s whatever. I need to show up every once in a while or even you won’t be able to make up an excuse for me.
Ehh...I’m not sure how true that statement is. I’ve marked Yumi as present every day so far and no one’s even questioned it.
How would the staff even know?
: You seem to be in a good mood today.
: Oh yeah? Why do you say that?
: You haven’t threatened to rip my genitalia off yet, so that’s a start.
: Say “genitalia” one more time and I guarantee you that’ll change.
: No thanks. I’m good.
: Good.
: And, umm...
: Sorry about freaking out on you the other day. I think the cafe thing got to me more than it should have.
Is Yumi...apologizing?
This counts as character growth, doesn’t it?
Is that what’s happening here?
: The fuck you gettin’ all quiet for? Ain't you supposed to be like “It’s okay. No big deal” or some shit like that?
: I’m new to this whole apologizin’ thing but I’m at least mature enough to admit when I’ve fucked up.
: I feel like that statement would carry a lot of weight if it weren’t for you constantly tormenting Futaba.
: You haven’t really apologized for that yet.
: Fuck Futaba. Why would I give a shit about her?
: Well, why would you give a shit about me?
: I don’t! That’s not what I meant!
: You can jump off a cliff for all I fucking care! You and Futaba both!
: Actually, scratch that. Pretty sure Japan would collapse if Futaba jumped off a cliff. You can just do it by yourself.
Well, at least it was a solid minute or two of tame conversation with Yumi this morning.
Asking for any more than that would just be selfish.
: Top o' the mornin', captain! Molly MacCormack reporting in for duty.
: Molly, you know you don’t have to report to me every single morning, right?
: Molly?...
: The fuck is a Molly?
: I am a Molly. 75%% Water and 25%% passion.
: Are you Yumi?
: I’ve heard many troubling things about you. Ms. Watabe’s class referred to you as the “ghost delinquent.”
: ...The fuck are you even talkin' about?
: Sir! I humbly request your protection from this individual! I believe I may have offended her.
: No, I don’t think so. Yumi always looks like that. You’ll get used to her in time.
: If she shows up to[school], that is.
: Hey! Watch it, douchebag. Don’t think I don’t realize when you’re being sarcastic.
: I feel like I’m sarcastic for a good portion of the day.
: Yeah. Which is one of the many fucking reasons I’m sick of talking to you.
: ...Woah.
: ...Woah, what? What are you lookin’ at?
: So much power...
: Molly, I don’t think that’s a good-
: Teach me your ways...
: I’ve never considered converting to the dark side before, but I can tell your skill in bravery far surpasses anyone else in the[school].
: Tell me, Yumi...Would you be willing to trade your knowledge in the dark arts in exchange for mine in holy magic?
: If we combine forces, I feel we could become unstoppable...
: Yo, is this girl in one of those “special” classes? I’m not sure if it’s socially acceptable to be mean right now or not.
: Actually, Yumi, she’s in your class now.
: What?! Since when?! How the fuck did this happen?!
: What’s wrong, Yumi? Don’t tell me someone like you is afraid of holy magic?...
: Where the fuck are you even from?! What kind of a name is Molly?!
: She’s from Ireland.
: Ireland?! Get the fuck away from me, Leprechaun!
: ...Fine. But you haven’t seen the last of me.
: Good day, sir.
: Molly, don’t say good day. I’ll be in there in like two minutes.
: I said good day.
Molly disappears into the classroom and Yumi is left exhausted and frustrated, typical symptoms that arise from one’s first meeting with the Emerald Whatever of Whatever Forest.
: What...the fuck...happened...while I was away?
: Plenty of things happen while you’re away, Yumi. In fact, we’re supposed to be getting-
: Hm? Why’d you stop talkin’?
: Yumi, whatever you do, don’t look to your right. I don’t think your heart is ready for another surprise this early in the morning.
: Don’t look to my right? What do you-
: The fuck is goin' on here?
: Is this a bad time?
: Not at all. What are you doing here, Tsuneyo?
: Ah-
...Is she really still doing that every time I say her name?
: I’m going to class.
: Oh, so you’re the second girl transferring in from Ms. Watabe’s?
: Correct. I will be in your care.
: Great. Yumi, this is Tsuneyo.
: Ah-
: Please stop that.
: I’m sorry. It’s a reflex.
: Tsuneyo, huh? And where the fuck are you from? England?
: Ramen.
: ...What?
: Sorry, Yumi. Tsuneyo is a little-
: Forget it...You were right. It is too early for this shit.
: That could have gone better.
: You’re telling me. Why did you tell her you were from ramen? That doesn’t even make sense.
: She’s the girl you brought to the ramen shop.
: That’s...yeah, you’re right.
: Are you friends outside of[school]?
: Friends? Yumi and me? Not even close.
: Do you spend time with all of your students outside of[school]?
If only you knew, Tsuneyo. If only you knew...
: I guess you could say that. I’m sort of a ‘hands-on’ type of teacher.
: Hands-on?
: It’s best if you don’t ask any questions.
: I see.
: Can I ask a question?
: I literally just told you not to ask any.
: This question isn’t related to your hands.
: ...Fine. Ask away.
: Um.
: What’s the proper way to introduce yourself to a new class?
: The proper way? I mean, as long as you don’t do it an improper way, it’s pretty successful.
: Yes, but it didn’t seem like anyone was particularly interested in me in my last class.
: I would like to make a better impression this time around.
: And you’re trusting me to tell you how even though we’ve only talked once?
: Yes. As I said, I am in your care. Please teach me to be a more interesting person who talks about more than just noodles.
: I thought you loved noodles.
: They are glorious.
: Listen...All you really need to do is be yourself and I’m sure things will be fine.
: The class might be filled with a bunch of misfits, myself included, but they’re pretty much all good people.
: I can be myself?
: You can be yourself.
: I understand.
: If this backfires, I am blaming you.
: Feel free...
Okay, so-
There’s definitely a good chance that this will backfire.
But the truth is that I also have no idea how to make a proper introduction.
Hell, on my first day of class, I started calling a group of [teenage]girls by their first names and let a girl hang out in the bathroom for twenty minutes.
But maybe Tsuneyo will actually be able to pull this off?
: Woah? Another new girl already?
: Didn’t we literally just get one?
: She’s...so pretty...
: Hm? Who’s that girl? Her socks are cute.
: Man, who the fuck even knows?
: Heheheh...
: Excellent...Excellent...
Tsuneyo stands in front of the class for at least twenty seconds without saying anything.
Should I have at least given her an intro or something along those lines? Yes. Definitely.
But if she is ever going to start seeming more...normal, this is something she will have to do on her own.
: Hello.
There we go. Great start, Tsuneyo.
: How does everyone feel about airline food?
Oh dear god no.
: Airline food? You mean like...the stuff they have on airplanes?
: What else would that possibly mean, Miku?
: I don’t know! It’s a weird thing to ask! Don’t get on my heckin’ case about it!
: I-It’s the worst! Isn’t that right, everybody?! Hahahahaha~
: Ami...what are you doing?
: Maya, shh! I think it’s like, an ice breaker thingy! We’ve gotta go along with it! You see how nervous she is?
That’s “my” [niece], alright. Doing what I’m incapable of and trying to set the mood of the room back to normal.
Unfortunately, I don’t think Tsuneyo hears her as she just continues standing there awkwardly.
: Tsuneyo.
: Ah-
: Tell them what you do for work.
: For work?
: Yeah. Just be yourself.
: I understand.
Tsuneyo takes a deep breath and composes herself before speaking to the class again.
: My name is Tsuneyo Tojo and I love noodles.
: ...Noodles?
: See? What did I fuckin’ say?
: Tell us about your favorite noodles, Tsuneyo!
Rin chimes in and tries to hype up Tsuneyo in a...slightly more convincing way than Ami did.
: Ramen.
: My family owns a ramen shop in the old district and I aim to one day take over when my father can no longer work.
: Ramen?! Ami, Maya, let’s go after[school]!
: I can’t go to the old district.
: Yeah, isn’t that place like a bajillion miles away? It’s like, crazy hot out and I don't really wanna walk.
: Maybe some other time?
: Ugh! Sana!
: H-Huh?...What?
: We’re getting ramen after[school]!
: But...I have-
: SANA!
: O-Okay...We will...get ramen...
: What else...do you like, Tsuneyo?
Wow, even Futaba is getting in on this intro. She's not normally one to call out.
Is it wrong for me to feel a little proud right now?
I know I don’t really teach any of these girls anything, but I’m glad that most of them are at least acting like moderately decent human beings.
: What else?
: I did Kendo when I was younger...
: Weebnote: Kendo is a traditional Japanese martial art where combatants use bamboo swords and armor to beat each other up!
: We know what Kendo is...We’re Japanese.
: Yes, but not all of the players are!
: Emerald Guardian...
: That is right...It is I! Molly MacCormack! Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest!
: And I am here to tell you, Tsuneyo Tojo, Kendo Princess of the Golden Desert-
: Princess?...
: Kendo Princess of the Golden Desert...that I would like to recruit you!
: Recruit me?...For what?
: From the moment I first laid eyes on you...I knew you were special. I knew you had potential!
: And as soon as you mentioned Kendo, I knew you had to be mine.
: I’ve...never been in a relationship before.
: What? No. I meant like, partners. Friends.
: Oh. That is significantly less embarrassing.
: Agreed!
: So, whaddya say? Wanna team up with this perky Irish lass to take down the world?
: Are you sure it’s okay? I always thought you didn’t like me.
: Do not mistake my passion for distaste! I love you in a completely platonic way!
: And also...
: I need a roommate!
: A roommate?
: I kinda can’t move into the dorms unless I have someone to room with, and everybody else is already taken.
: You move quickly.
: I’m a girl who knows what she likes.
: Me too. It’s-
: Noodles. I know.
: It’s like we’re already connected.
: We are connected.
: Are they...going to kiss?
: What?...
: Kiss her!
: Y-Yeah! Do it!
: What? No I-
: I’m...ready...
: Ready for what?!
In case you were wondering, the two of them never kissed.
At least not to my knowledge.
For all I know, they could have left[school] together and just started making out or something.
But I guess that’s just wishful thinking.
Either way, I’m glad that Tsuneyo’s introduction went...mostly well.
She’s still incredibly awkward and Molly’s still...Molly...But at least I feel like both of them are going to fit in just fine...
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
Tsuneyo’s affection has increased to [tsuneyo_love]!
